value.title: I Was a Faceless, Evil NPC Heiress
value.synopsis: A recently dumped budding paleobotanist finds herself reincarnated as a background character in an otome game.

value.title: Tea Party with the Love Interests
value.synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Pia gets a royal opportunity to make new friends despite her fiancé's overprotective nature.

value.title: Enrolling on the Set of an Otome Game?!
value.synopsis: Pia spends time getting to know her friends Erin and Henry as she adjusts to her new position at the academy.

value.title: The Overprotective, Cunning Fiance
value.synopsis: Pia receives an unexpected visit from Uncle Johnny, who gives her a job offer that sounds too good to be true.
